scripts.check:secrets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const bad=['GEMINI_API_KEY','ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','OPENAI_API_KEY','UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN','BETA_USERS','AUTH_SESSION_SECRET'];const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):[path.join(d,e.name)]);const hits=[];for(const f of walk('dist')){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');for(const k of bad){if(s.includes(k))hits.push(f+':'+k);}}if(hits.length){console.error('Secret token name leaked in client bundle:',hits);process.exit(1);}console.log('Bundle secret scan clean.');"
scripts.qa: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run check:secrets
